definitions.explanation: The first of the three bases a runner reaches in baseball, and by extension the player who fields that position.

examples.japanese: {一塁|いちるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦バッター→バッター：27284_battaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一塁|いちるい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アウト→アウト：00007_auto⟧になった。
examples.english: The batter was out at first.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一塁|いちるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ランナー→ランナー：09483_rannaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{球|たま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二塁|にるい}→二塁：32002_nirui⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{盗塁|とうるい}→盗塁：31887_tourui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The runner who reached first on a hit stole second on the next pitch.

notes:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {塁|るい} (base). The bases are {一塁|いちるい}, ⟦{二塁|にるい}→二塁：32002_nirui⟧, ⟦{三塁|さんるい}→三塁：31673_sanrui⟧, and home plate, {本塁|ほんるい} or ⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一塁手|いちるいしゅ}→一塁手：27488_ichiruishu⟧: first baseman
- {一塁|いちるい}⟦ランナー→ランナー：09483_rannaa⟧: runner on first
- {一塁|いちるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get on first base
- {一塁|いちるい}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the first-base side (of the stands)

WATCH OUT:
ファースト is the everyday spoken word for both the base and the player; {一塁|いちるい} is the standard term in broadcasts and newspapers.
